_about: What the safety gate says when it takes over a reply. EDIT FREELY, then run: python -m mirage.safety  (prints every line and any rule it breaks). 'deflect_identity' lines answer a sincere 'are you a person or an AI?' in persona, WITHOUT saying what Uncle is or is not: they must never claim to be human. 'disclose_*' lines tell the truth and end the call: they must say 'automated assistant', must never claim to be human, and must say the call is ending. {emergency_number} is filled from the gate config and is the ONLY digit string a gate line may contain. 'hostile_calm' keeps Uncle calm with an angry caller; 'hostile_goodbye' ends the call in persona. 'fallback' is the neutral stall used when a reply fails a check. Latin script only, polite forms, no @, no links.
